title_en: Near Lake I Thate, 2+1 Apartment For Sale With Plan, Orientation And Perfect Location!!
description_en: At Liqini i Thate, near Radisson Hotel, Super Apartment 2+1+2 for sale, with regular floor plan!! The apartment is located on the 3rd floor of a 6-story building and is organized by a distribution corridor, a living room with a kitchenette and access to the balcony, two bedrooms, one of which has a dedicated toilet and a window, another toilet and a balcony. The apartment has a great orientation, from the east and the west and has a wonderful view of the dry lake. The area in which the apartment is located is one of the most preferred areas for living, as it is located near two lakes, for the clean air and tranquility it offers. It is also a very good opportunity for investment considering the rents in the area.
